views.text: In February 2023, Equity Mates explained Microsoft planned a multi‑year push to integrate generative AI like ChatGPT across all its products, with OpenAI running on Azure, showing how AI could enhance its software and services.

episode.title: Why did Microsoft invest $10bn in ChatGPT?

views.text: In July 2022, Equity Mates outlined Microsoft’s breadth of products from Windows and productivity software to cloud, gaming and hardware, noting it had become embedded across consumer and enterprise computing over decades.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In May 2025, Equity Mates reported Microsoft’s quarterly revenue of US$70 billion, up 13%, and profit near US$26 billion, up 18%, with a 37% profit margin, highlighting margins well above a typical S&P 500 company.

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In November 2023, Equity Mates said Microsoft announced leaders from OpenAI would join to head a new AI research team and pledged resources, signalling aggressive reinvestment into AI capability after the OpenAI turmoil.

views.text: In January 2024, an adviser on Equity Mates cautioned that valuation differentials could drive mean reversion out of the Meg Seven, which would affect Microsoft, a roughly 7% holding in the fund.
